notes.title: 0.6.9 update is live
notes.content:
Changelog:
This release fixes a bunch of random bugs and regressions
[list]
[*] Updated engine to 4.23.1
[*] Fixed hiding place cameras
[*] Fixed dialogues in 1st level 
[*] Fixed issues that prevented a S++ rating in 1st level
[*] Fixed issues when killing target in sauna
[*] Fixed animation freezing when picking up items
[*] Fixed issue with unkillable target in training level
[*] And some other small bugs fixed
[/list]

notes.title: 0.6.8 update is live
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Updated engine to 4.23
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Graphics improvements
[*] Ability to climb over walls
[*] Added usable item highlighting
[*] Added throw trail
[*] Fixed some AI pathfinding issues
[*] Fixed issues with gunshot sounds
[*] Fixed gun animations & left hand IK
[*] Added better wound decals
[*] Reduced game install size
[*] Reduced load times
[*] Bushes now react to player movement and body disposal
[*] Some minor UI improvements
[*] Increased player health and made AI less aggressive
[*] Major foliage improvements - fixed tree LODs and distant tree shadows
[/list]

notes.title: 0.6.7 update
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
    [*]Mirrors and sea reflections can now be disabled in graphics options
    [*]Objectives that don't require killing are now optional
    [*]All objectives are required for S rating and above
[/list]

notes.title: 0.6.6 update
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
[*]The player can now climb through windows.
[*]Fixed Behaviour Tree bugs that caused AI to lock up
[*]More consistent body throwing
[*]Fixed issues when dragging bodies out of chairs
[*]Added suspicion meters for each enemy
[*]Fixed mirror-related performance issues in 1st level
[/list]

notes.title: 0.6.5 update for Mac
notes.content: Sorry for the delay, but the 0.6.5 update is now available for Mac as well.

notes.title: 0.6.5 update
notes.content:
Decided to not work on the 3rd level yet and did some polishing instead.
Changelog:
[list]
 [*]Updated UE to 4.20.3
 [*]Gamepad support.
 [*]Auto Aim.
 [*]Combined Aim/Shoot for people with 1-button mice.
 [*]Fixed guard dialogues in the 1st mission.
 [*]Target dialogue should no longer lock up.
 [*]Added cubemap reflections to cars and most glass surfaces.
 [*]Fixed issues with planar reflections.
 [*]Fixed lighting issues in training level.
 [*]Improved skin and hair materials.
 [*]Removed/resized all npot textures.
 [*]Added "Cinematic" graphics options.
 [*]Lighting and post processing adjustments.
 [*]Fixed NPC sitting animations.
 [*]NPCs will no longer collide with the camera.
 [*]Fixed bugs when taking down sitting enemies.
 [*]Fixed bugs that caused enemies to not hear explosions.
 [*]It now requires more than one tazer shot to take down the player.
 [*]Button prompts are no longer hardcoded and support remapped controls.
 [*]It's now possible to close inventory without changing the equipped item.
 [*]It's now possible to run through bushes.
 [*]Added particle effects to EMP explosives.
 [*]Explosives will now kill anything in 5 m radius and won't be affected by level geometry.
 [*]Removed navigation modifier under player when not in combat - AI will no longer try to avoid them.
 [*]Crosshair will now show the actual location that the bullet will hit.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.6.4 Update
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
    [*]Updated UE to 4.20.1 
    [*]Fixed performance issues during combat. (Some hitches might still be present - I'll try to fix them in the future)
    [*]It's now possible to take gardener's clothes in the 1st mission
    [*]It's now possible to obtain documents from both the target's and security computers
    [*]Reduced enemy speed
[*]Fixed enemy pathfinding issues
[*]Target now leaves his computer more frequently
[/list]
